title: Atlas common definitions
description: Reusable $defs referenced by the envelope and event payload schemas. See docs/architecture/schemas/README.md.

Ulid.description: ULID identifier (used for messageId/correlationId and most entity ids).

ChannelId.description: Channel/tenant scope id; present on every row and message.

RenditionKind.description: The kind of generated media version.

TechnicalMetadata.description: ffprobe-derived technical metadata; additive fields allowed.

EntityRef.description: A generic pointer to any Atlas entity, used by cross-cutting events (tasks, notifications, alerts, publishing, audit).

entityId.description: Id of the referenced entity (usually a ULID; may be an external id for feed items).

Severity.description: Uniform severity for notifications, tasks and alerts.

TaskKind.description: Kind of human-in-the-loop task. One definition: BMS declares it in a workflow, emits it in workflow.task.created, and Notifications re-emits it in task.created — three sites had two value sets (workflow.task.created could not express 'generic').

PrincipalKind.description: Who a task is assigned to, or a message addressed to.

UserState.description: IAM account state; a state machine with coded transitions (lockout, invitation).

SettingScope.description: Levels a Tier-3 setting can be written at. Resolution is nearest-wins: code default -> deployment -> channel -> category -> user (design §2.5).

AiTier.description: Which AI tier ran: online (interactive, bounded latency) or offline (batch). Not the HSM storage Tier.

AiTask.description: An enrichment task; each is its own model pipeline in the AI service.

PublishKind.description: An outbound publishing connector; each is its own integration.
